operational_fee_wallet.purpose: TON network fees and authorized operational transaction costs only
operational_fee_wallet.owner_deposit_instruction: Owner deposits TON intended for network fees into this wallet only.

founder_vesting.controller: immutable minter deployment admin; minter_admin_address must be the founder wallet
founder_vesting.note: Two deterministic escrow instances are created by the minter after one-time start-time configuration. Mint only to the founder escrow; no direct beneficiary mint.

notes: Template only. Vesting escrow source and minter integration have been added to the draft security branch; they are not merged, deployed, audited, or Testnet-verified. Set minter_admin_address to the founder wallet before deployment; it is the immutable release controller for both escrows. The five allocation owner wallet candidates are recorded in allocation_wallets; verify wallet control on the intended network before any transfer. The operational fee wallet is separate and TON-only. Keep escrow/master addresses null until derived and verified. Null contract/deployment fields require owner approval. Never commit secrets, seed phrases or private keys. No deployment or transfer is authorized by this template.

allocation_wallet_verification.note: These are recorded owner wallet candidates, not derived Jetton wallet contract addresses. Verify control on the intended network before any transfer.

mining_reserve_vesting.controller: immutable minter deployment admin; minter_admin_address must be the founder wallet
mining_reserve_vesting.note: Separate deterministic escrow instance holds the mining reserve and releases linearly over 730 days to the recorded mining wallet. Mint only to the escrow, never directly to beneficiary.

vesting_escrow_implementation.deployment: two separate deterministic instances derived by VcoinMinter from its address, escrow code, vesting kind and approved start_time
vesting_escrow_implementation.controller: minter_admin_address; must equal founder allocation wallet
vesting_escrow_implementation.mint_gate: both escrow instances must acknowledge deployment readiness before any allocation mint
vesting_escrow_implementation.deposit_gate: founder and mining allocations count as issued only after escrow deposit acknowledgement
vesting_escrow_implementation.release: linear integer base-unit accrual; no admin bypass; monotonic query IDs; wallet success/failure acknowledgement and bounce recovery
